findings.reason: moving the reprocessability write into reset.py (the owner §14 itself names) removes the duplicate writer and replaces the argument-presence trigger with an explicit, root-scoped reset, so the fixed end-state is reached through one mechanism rather than two.
findings.text: §14 clears expanded_at from two places: inside the seed item map when root_paths was supplied (frontier.py:528) and, via clear_fields, in PATH_RESET_SPECS (reset.py:245, :252). §14's stated reason for the extra seed writer — "--root is the only root-scoped entry point while the reset is facility-wide" — is inaccurate: reset_to_status already takes extra_filter/extra_params (reset.py:63, applied at reset.py:87) and the signals CLI already scopes a reset with them (cli/discover/signals.py:224-228). A root-scoped path filter on the existing reset (the same shape the signals command uses) is therefore the single-owner change, not a second writer. Keying the new behaviour on the presence of root_paths is also ambiguous: three callers pass root_paths (cli/discover/paths.py:262 for --root, cli/discover/__init__.py:312 for `discover seed --path`, frontier.py:640 via seed_missing_roots), so §14's "supplied explicitly" trigger silently changes the seed's contract for two callers that are not the intended reprocess entry point.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — neither remaining section introduces a module; §14 adds a conditional inside one existing function (frontier.py:426) and one key to clear_fields, §20 adds a single graph-tier test file, so there is no new interface to weigh against what it hides.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14 makes seed_facility_roots a second writer of expanded_at beside the owner it names, PATH_RESET_SPECS, whose reset path already supports caller scoping.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 adds no new symbol (a branch in an existing function plus an entry in PATH_RESET_SPECS.clear_fields) and §20 adds only a test file, so none of the four families grows.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 cites seed_facility_roots (frontier.py:426), create_nodes (graph/client.py:605), claim_paths_for_expanding (paths/parallel.py:520) and PATH_RESET_SPECS (base/reset.py:240) and every claim about them checks out (SET n += item at client.py:668 removes a null property; the claim predicate at parallel.py:547-549 matches the plan's text); §20 cites render_chunk_source (graph/query_builder.py:68) and the tests/graph live-graph pattern it follows.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no wrapper layer is proposed; §14 extends the existing seed and reset mechanisms in place and §20 adds a test with an explicit "no source changes, no new helper".
